body:
Source-only review correction pushed in `114477a5`: recovery now requires inspect/review of existing Compose/authentication/mounts/ports, preservation of protected configuration, separate explicit replacement approval, and explicit `restart` before Setup. No credential-only update, token rotation, auth downgrade, or shared/registry/normalization change.

The SAME existing failing-hint test was renamed/strengthened (no new cases/functions/files): red before the fix, green afterward; it directly asserts approval/preservation boundaries and restart versus non-reloading start. The proof now labels the previous reinstall result as healthy-token reuse, not token-drift recovery. No Docker, browser, e2e runtime or host/provider probes were run for this correction.

Focused Aria2/Homarr tests, gofmt, build, both vet gates, relevant race tests, Bash syntax and diff checks passed. Initial full Go run failed the unchanged `TestCommandDeadlineRetainsSanitizedTermination` and `TestPassboltApplicationMetadataWrapperRejectsExpandedAccess` fixtures; full `go test -p 1 ./...` passed unchanged.

Correction delta from `e89556fc953de228cfac0bc03ab67e439a8a1001`: four owned files, 42 additions/7 removals. Fixed source base remains `5aafb4c1833fd4cd9caf0f7beaac31e625aafe22`. Draft remains held for fresh independent Standards/Spec reviews and final contract normalization/registration, real native/rendered acceptance, both orders and shared lifecycle. No merge or stage-2 completion claim.

Both fresh independent SOURCE reviews pass with zero findings at 114477a54418376a9c8e3c9182446a8bcffb4d36 against fixed actual implementation parent 5aafb4c1833fd4cd9caf0f7beaac31e625aafe22. The recovery P2 is resolved: inspection, protected-configuration preservation and separate Compose replacement approval precede approved reinstall, then explicit restart and Setup reload the RPC configuration. The same existing test checks these safeguards; no new test case or shared wiring was added. Previous healthy-token reinstall evidence is explicitly not token-drift recovery proof. Reported local gates passed, including the full serialized Go suite after two unchanged fixture failures; reviewers did not rerun them. This remains stage-1 prerequisite/source acceptance only. Keep draft: final descriptor verifier/normalization/registration, real native/rendered data, credential-drift recovery, both installation orders and shared lifecycle remain unverified; #269 stays open.

Fresh complete source review at `71e5c0fc1afd1732a38b299137f0001ed99a19d3`, against fixed `6b82c55fb890c11a1388bd4e5a2f10b632ff4f7c` (five files, +536/-42).

## Standards

**PASS — zero P0–P3 findings.** Prior P3 closed: `target_aria2.go` and its proof reference now follow the documented peer seam. No actionable documented-rule breaches or Fowler-smell findings. Common/registry/helper/dependency files remain unchanged.

## Spec

**PASS — zero P0–P3 findings.** Prior P2 closed: RPC, native Downloads and refreshed Stats validate independently instead of requiring volatile cross-sample equality. Duplicate IDs are checked within each response; native list paused semantics remain separate from the Stats one-item window. Saved identity/credential/destination, authenticated version/directory, required arrays, typed fields/ranges, supported units and central advancing freshness remain checked. Missing/authentication/unsupported data still fails; no fabricated zeros, anonymous fallback, arbitrary tolerance or added retry loop. Approved replacement/restart recovery is preserved.

Parent verified clean local/live-remote and current draft PR head. The owner executed mandatory offline gates; reviewers did not rerun them. No new tests, dependencies or runtime were added.

**Summary: Standards 0; Spec 0 — source only.** Aria2 remains individually unregistered; actual native/rendered data, both installation orders, credential/resource preservation and removal/reinstall lifecycle remain unproved. The sampling correction has not been exercised live. Keep #269 open and this PR draft; no runtime retry, merge or full acceptance approval is conveyed.
